The alternative reading Delta^2 = (sigma_1 sigma_2)^3 (full twist, generator of the centre) closes to the torus link T(3,3), also Seifert-fibered with V_hyp = 0. Under either reading the Garside trajectory belongs with the 'V_hyp = 0' class the preceding sentence assigns to torus knots, not with Borromean. Borromean itself is correct: the closure of (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^3 is the Borromean rings, hyperbolic, Vol = 7.32772. Proposed: move 'Garside' to the Seifert-fibered sentence, or state which curve 'Garside trajectory' denotes if it is not the closure of Delta.
